text.en: Bytetrack is row 104 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Detection Segmentation area.
text.zh: Bytetrack 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 104 行，所属领域为“检测与分割”。

text.en: The annual table associates Bytetrack with “Bytetrack: Multi-object tracking by associating every detection box”.
text.zh: 年度表把 Bytetrack 与论文《Bytetrack: Multi-object tracking by associating every detection box》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Yifu Zhang, Xinggang Wang”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 Yifu Zhang（官方页拼写）、Xinggang Wang（官方页拼写）；官方英文原文为“Yifu Zhang, Xinggang Wang”。
